title: Market note where every citation exists, every quote is verbatim and every number recomputes (clean control)

proof.python:

n = pathlib.Path('note.md').read_text()

s1 = ' '.join(s1.split())
s3 = pathlib.Path('sources/S3-interview-notes.md').read_text()
assert 'may delete personal data within 30 days of a verified request, unless a legal hold or an overriding retention duty applies' in s1
assert 'We moved from per-seat to per-workspace pricing in the spring, and churn in the smallest tier fell' in s3
assert 'within 72 hours' in s1
assert round((2.8 - 2.4) / 2.4 * 100, 1) == 16.7 and round(1240 / 38) == 33
